item.text: I’ll trace the authentication configuration decoding and its startup validation, record the work in the required checkpoint, then make the smallest validation change and run the relevant existing tests.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: validate required GitHub and OIDC authentication fields at startup, including GitHub "'`read:org` when organizations are restricted.

Progress: locating the configuration types, validation path, and relevant existing tests. No implementation changes yet.
EOF
find .. -name AGENTS.md -print; find . -maxdepth 4 -type f | head -200'

GitHub’s validator currently checks only scopes, and OIDC’s is empty, so I’m adding provider-specific required-field checks there to keep rejection at the existing startup validation boundary.

The validation now returns the required provider and field wording, and treats whitespace-only values as empty. The config package test command is still running; I’m waiting for its result and will inspect the final diff afterward.

item.text:
Implemented startup validation for enabled GitHub authentication and each configured OIDC provider. Missing or whitespace-only `client_id`, `client_secret`, or `redirect_address` now returns an error naming the provider and field. GitHub’s missing `read:org` error uses the required format.

Updated the existing GitHub scope validation test expectation. Verification passed: `go test ./internal/config`.
